snapshots.name: Ishmael
snapshots.subtitle: The narrator, a schoolteacher turned sailor
snapshots.body: Restless ashore and drawn to the sea whenever he feels a certain damp, drizzly November in his soul, he signs aboard the whaling ship Pequod out of Nantucket. Everything the reader knows of the voyage comes filtered through his account.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Queequeg
snapshots.subtitle: A tattooed harpooneer from the South Seas
snapshots.body: A cannibal chief's son turned professional harpooneer, Ishmael meets him unexpectedly sharing a bed at the Spouter-Inn in New Bedford and the two quickly become close friends. He signs onto the Pequod alongside Ishmael.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Captain Ahab
snapshots.subtitle: The Pequod's captain
snapshots.body: Aged, scarred, and missing a leg to an old encounter with a whale, he keeps to his cabin for much of the early voyage, sighted only rarely by the crew. What he intends to do with this particular cruise is not yet common knowledge aboard ship.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Starbuck
snapshots.subtitle: The Pequod's first mate
snapshots.body: A steady, deeply religious Nantucketer who values prudence and profit over reckless daring. His growing unease about Ahab's private purposes for the voyage sets him apart from the rest of the officers.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Stubb
snapshots.subtitle: The Pequod's second mate
snapshots.body: Easygoing and almost impossible to rattle, he takes danger and hardship with a joke and his ever-present pipe. His good humor is its own kind of armor against the voyage's darker turns.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Flask
snapshots.subtitle: The Pequod's third mate
snapshots.body: Short, stout, and pugnacious, he treats whales as personal grudges to be settled rather than as anything to be feared. He is nicknamed King-Post by the crew for his short, solid build.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Tashtego
snapshots.subtitle: Starbuck's harpooneer, a Gay Head Indian
snapshots.body: A skilled whaleman from Martha's Vineyard, prized for his eye and his nerve at the head of a whaleboat. He serves under Starbuck through the cruise.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Daggoo
snapshots.subtitle: Flask's harpooneer, an African giant
snapshots.body: Towering and imposing, he serves as harpooneer in Flask's boat despite his captain's much smaller stature. His size makes him one of the most striking figures on deck.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Fedallah
snapshots.subtitle: Ahab's secret harpooneer
snapshots.body: A Parsee smuggled aboard before the voyage began, revealed only once the Pequod is well out to sea, along with a boat crew no one else knew was aboard. His strange prophecies unsettle even Ahab.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Pip
snapshots.subtitle: The ship's small black cabin boy
snapshots.body: Lively and given to tambourine-playing early in the voyage, he is pressed into service in a whaleboat and left alone in open water after jumping from fright, an experience that changes him permanently. Ahab takes an unexpected interest in him afterward.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Captain Peleg
snapshots.subtitle: A retired whaling captain, part-owner of the Pequod
snapshots.body: Blustering and profane despite his Quaker upbringing, he handles the hiring of the crew in Nantucket alongside his old friend Bildad. He is the one who first tells Ishmael and Queequeg about Ahab's missing leg.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Captain Bildad
snapshots.subtitle: A retired whaling captain, part-owner of the Pequod
snapshots.body: Thrifty to a fault and outwardly pious, he haggles over Ishmael's and Queequeg's shares of the voyage's profits with hard-nosed precision. He and Peleg together represent the ship's absent owners.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Father Mapple
snapshots.subtitle: A former whaleman turned preacher
snapshots.body: He preaches a sermon on Jonah from a pulpit shaped like a ship's bow at the New Bedford seamen's chapel, just before Ishmael sets out for Nantucket. His sermon casts a long shadow over everything that follows.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Elijah
snapshots.subtitle: A ragged stranger who warns Ishmael on the dock
snapshots.body: He accosts Ishmael and Queequeg on the wharf at Nantucket with cryptic, ominous questions about Ahab and the voyage they are about to join. Neither of them can quite tell if he is mad or simply better informed than he lets on.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Moby Dick
snapshots.subtitle: A legendary white sperm whale
snapshots.body: Known among whalemen for his immense size, his pale color, and his history of turning on the boats sent after him. Whatever business Ahab has with this particular whale, he has not yet explained it to the crew.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.
